svg.aria-label: F06 — could anyone have told, under noise? Two separate experiments, never spliced
svg.desc: Detection rate of the pre-registered curvature test against added pressure noise, on a logarithmic horizontal axis from 1 to 80 psi, in two panels. The upper panel is the original sweep at 400 replicates: the water-drive detection rate, the positive control, falls from 1.00 at 1 psi through 0.555 at 10 psi to 0.0725 at 80 psi, drawn with circle markers; the volumetric-null rejection rate, the negative control, is flat at 0.0675 at every level, drawn with square markers on a sparse dotted line. The lower panel is a separate post-review experiment at 4000 replicates and a different seed, measuring the power curve between 8 and 16 psi: it falls from 0.75375 at 8 psi to 0.29700 at 16 psi, drawn with diamond markers. The two experiments are in separate panels and are never joined into one curve. Reference rules are drawn at a detection rate of 0.5 and at the nominal size of 0.05. Full values in the two data tables below the figure.

svg.text: The measured quantities are the discrete points. Every connecting line in this figure is a visual guide between computed sigma levels and carries no

svg.text: Two distinct events are distinguished and never pooled: detecting curvature in a water-drive history (the alternative) and rejecting the straight line on a

svg.text: A separate post-review experiment with its own replicate count and seed. It is not spliced into the original sweep.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"

svg.text: Rates are exact, not rounded: at 400 replicates every rate is a multiple of 0.0025. One seed, reset identically at every sigma. So the seven levels are

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"

svg.text: rescalings of one draw set rather than seven independent experiments, and the 0.0675 null rate is a high draw of that seed, not the detector's size:

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"

svg.text: pooled over 20000 replicates on a fresh seed it is 0.0473.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"

svg.text: The null rate is identical at every noise level because the null p/Z series is exactly linear, so the t statistic is scale-invariant.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"
